name: SPANA re-ID v2 (DINOv2 ViT-S/14 fine-tuned, part-pooled 256-d embedding)
preprocessing: box + crop_pad on each side, clipped; resize to input_hw (INTER_AREA when shrinking, else INTER_LINEAR); BGR->RGB; /255; ImageNet mean/std (tools/reid_crops.cut_crop + tools/reid_train.to_input)
licence: weights trained by SPANA on SPANA-licensed TRAIN matches; backbone Apache-2.0
note: The ONNX file is not in git (*.onnx ignored); place it at models/spana_reid_v2/spana_reid.onnx. A different file is refused.
